digest.component_or_area: CI/CD infrastructure — Ubuntu job performance and test efficiency
propositions: Ubuntu default-suite jobs occupy 30.2 runner-minutes per Verified run (py3.11=615s, py3.12=634s, py3.13=563s baseline) due to redundant YAML parsing in bridge cadence test and subprocess overhead in Pandoc corpus rendering

Bridge cadence test calls _bridge_schedule() 1,440 times within a single test, loading and parsing the same workflow YAML repeatedly (measured YAML I/O cost=342.22s per Verified run) instead of hoisting the parse once before the comprehension

Pandoc render_unit and hardening tests invoke real Pandoc 3,421+ times per run for corpus and hardening assertions but could replace 883 of 884 redundant legacy-side conversions with committed golden fixtures while preserving all 884 live product conversions and satisfying ADR 0095
AST provenance fixture setup spends 46.95-55.60s per Ubuntu cell repeatedly rediscovering caller and parent relationships via 9.54M ast.walk iterations instead of building indices once per process

Complexity-lock static policy runs redundantly in all four pytest matrix cells (Ubuntu 52-55s × 3 + macOS 45s) instead of executing once in the lint job, causing ~154 runner-seconds waste per Verified run
Jira DC-oriented tests are already excluded from Verified hot path via 'not integration and not external' selector; moving them saves zero runner-minutes and reducing coverage is unjustified
